what: Estimate prevalence and its precision — estimate_prevalence
title: Estimate prevalence and its precision — estimate_prevalence
text: Analysis function: given observed counts, returns prevalence point estimate confidence interval. Three CI methods available: "wald" (default) Symmetric unless end moved 0 1. \(\hat{p} \pm z \cdot SE\). Can narrow small samples prevalence near 0 1. "clopper-pearson" Asymmetric. Exact binomial interval, via beta distribution. simple random sample, coverage least stated confidence level, usually wider Wald interval. "agresti-coull" Asymmetric. Wald interval calculated adding \(z^2/2\) positive \(z^2/2\) negative cases data (1.92 95 percent). moves interval towards 0.5; reported prevalence unchanged. methods account imperfect diagnostic tests (Rogan-Gladen correction) clustered sampling (Kish design effect). icc supplied, estimated data (observed variance sites compared variance expected every person independent). Setting icc = 0 treats every person independent; people site tend similar, gives interval narrow.
